house_look: Match locked I-01 and I-02. Bold even outlines, full cave or dungeon room, large colorable shapes, no words, no black blobs, no blank holes, no frames.
must_have_every_page: closed openings or openings filled with the next room
same bold line weight as I-01 and I-02
opening_rule: A crack, door, window, mouth, or tunnel must show the next room: joists, boards, stone slabs, or a closed door. Never a white void and never a black void.
texture_rule: Big slabs, big armor plates, simple wood boards. No dense grain, no tiny floor tiles, no strand hair.
ink_rule: Outlines only. Every white region must be colorable. No black blobs, no filled shadows, no solid voids.
line_rule: Same bold even outline as locked I-01 and I-02.
